The change matches the task. Payments are bucketed by their `CreatedAt` in the organization's zone, which is the only time field a payment has. Time zones are validated on org creation, so `LoadLocation` cannot fail for stored orgs. Bucket generation covers every bucket from the one holding `from` through the one holding `to`, and the 366-day check rejects exactly the ranges over 366 days. Week and month starts are computed correctly, and the DST and boundary tests use valid dates (2026-03-08 is the New York spring-forward day, 2026-02-15 is a Sunday). The `Revenue` signature is unchanged. I did not re-run the checks, since the evidence already shows build, test, lint and secrets passing.
